CREATE TRIGGER tr1 AFTER INSERT ON t1 BEGIN
    INSERT INTO x1 VALUES(
        new.a REGEXP 'abc',
        new.b REGEXP 'abc',
        new.c REGEXP 'abc'
    );
  END

CREATE TRIGGER tr2 AFTER INSERT ON t1 BEGIN
    INSERT INTO x2 VALUES(
        new.a REGEXP 'def',
        new.b REGEXP 'def',
        new.c REGEXP 'def'
    );
  END
UPDATE t2 SET a=a+1 WHERE b REGEXP 'a.*' AND b REGEXP '.*1'
